patch.value: contracts-command.spec.ts reads the developer's own tracker, so a locally installed calendar package fails two specs

Found while verifying PR #1761. tests/unit/commands/workspace/contracts-command.spec.ts calls runContracts with GLOBAL_OPTIONS, which has no path, so the tracker resolves from process.cwd(): the repository's own .agents/pm. Two specs ('returns schema, actions, command flags, and alias surfaces' and 'supports lightweight flags-only and availability-only projections') assert that the optional calendar action is unavailable (disabled_reason optional_package_not_installed:calendar). On a working copy where the bundled calendar package is installed into the repository tracker (the gitignored .agents/pm/extensions/builtin-calendar, present here since 2026-10-11), the action is available and both specs fail. CI passes because a fresh clone has no such package. The result depends on gitignored local state, so the full local suite is not reproducible across contributors.

Every runContracts call in contracts-command.spec.ts that asserts optional-package availability runs against an isolated temporary tracker (withTempPmPath) or an explicit noExtensions setting; Both specs pass with and without the calendar package installed in the repository tracker; A census of other specs that resolve the tracker from process.cwd() is recorded on this item
Specs pass regardless of which optional packages the developer installed into the repository tracker
Two contracts specs fail locally when builtin-calendar is installed in the repository tracker
